text: evam rāgavinayapariyosānaṃ yāva esanāpāli vitthāre tabbaṃ || || [Uddānaṃ] Cha pācīnato ninnā || Cha ninnā ca samuddato || Dve te cha dvādasa honti || Vaggo tena pavuccati || || Bojjhaṅgasaṃyuttassa Gaṅgāpeyyālam rāgavasena vitthāretabbaṃ || || Vaggo cuddasamo || || CHAPTER XV. APPAMĀDAVAGGO (Rāgavinaya-).
